God is in the midst of her; ehe shall not be moved : God shall help her, and that right earlt. The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved : he uttered his voice, the eart

Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I am against thee, O Tyrus, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.
